reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes OneCoin as a business and investment opportunity, cites rapid currency appreciation and company growth, and directly urges viewers to join. He explicitly calls it a multi-level company and presents its growing member and distributor network as part of the opportunity, making recruitment central to the pitch rather than merely discussing cryptocurrency.

citations.quote: 1,300,000 distributors members One Coins
multi-level marth company
It has an annual valuation of more than 700% of appreciation in less than a year.
come be part of this business

opening.argument: The speaker describes a developing currency and payment proposition, not a guaranteed personal return. His account is framed around claims about OneCoin's history, claimed price movement, and possible future payment use; he says it “will be possible” for virtual currencies to handle a share of money, which is a forecast, not a certainty. The title's “money of the future” is promotional, but the supplied speech does not state that viewers are guaranteed gains or tell them to invest a particular amount. That leaves room to read the claims as optimistic commentary about a speculative financial project rather than proof of a deceptive offer.

citations.quote: In few years it will be possible for all money 30% to 40% in virtual currencies.
Nowadays the numbers are so different.
OneCoin cryptocurrency the money of the future

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats the growth and appreciation figures as proof that recruitment is the central purpose. They are certainly promotional claims, but the quoted figures do not establish that a viewer is promised those results or paid for recruiting others. The speech also discusses payment infrastructure and currency design, so the network references alone do not resolve whether this is deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: It has an annual valuation of more than 700% of appreciation in less than a year.
a payment platform at a worldwide level where you can pay in any part of the world

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling this a forecast does not make the pitch cautious: the speaker pairs an extraordinary appreciation claim with a direct invitation to join the business and appeals to viewers' future gains. Nothing in the cited payment discussion qualifies the sales pitch or warns viewers that the claims may be unreliable.

citations.quote: It has an annual valuation of more than 700% of appreciation in less than a year.
come be part of this business

opening.argument: This can be read as a company presentation about the claimed development of a cryptocurrency and its intended payment uses. Much of the speech recounts launch timing, discusses a payment platform, compares the project with Bitcoin, and describes an intended global payment function. Those are explanatory topics about a business and its technology, not a demonstration that a viewer can earn money. The speaker's enthusiasm and invitation to participate make it promotional, but the supplied material does not show a tutorial for enrolling, paying, or recruiting others; nor does it establish what registration involves.

citations.quote: At the end of 2014, OneCoin was launched.
Our currency comes from the success bitcoin had, but we corrected a few of the issues caused by Bitcoin
a payment platform at a worldwide level where you can pay in any part of the world

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution points to the member count and invitation to join, but those do not erase the presentation's substantial discussion of the currency and payment service. The quoted “multi-level” phrase identifies a business model; it does not, by itself, show a tutorial in recruitment commissions or a deceptive mechanism. The material provided does not explain what a person must do after following the registration link.

citations.quote: multi-level marth company
come be part of this business

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The technology discussion serves the pitch rather than displacing it: the speaker repeatedly presents the business as an opportunity, cites appreciation and a large distributor network, and asks viewers to join. This is not a neutral operational explanation, and the absence of a step-by-step enrollment tutorial does not undo the solicitation visible in the speech.

citations.quote: 1,300,000 distributors members One Coins
this is the biggest opportunity of all times
come be part of this business

opening.argument: At most, the supplied material shows promotion of a currency-related business and payment service. It mentions a payment platform, accounts the company says it has or plans to have, and links to register, but it does not show a payment being made, a deposit being taken, a guaranteed return, or a recruitment commission being paid. The title and description invite interest, and the speaker makes strong claims; still, those claims alone do not establish the terms of registration or prove that ordinary commercial promotion crosses into a scam. The record leaves the actual transaction and any promised compensation mechanism unspecified.

citations.quote: Dr. Roujat decided to solve the problem once and for all she purchased OnePayment, a payment platform at a worldwide level
We're going to have accounts on four main banks

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution says recruitment is central because the speaker cites distributors and calls the company multi-level. But those excerpts do not describe commissions, a required downline, or how registration works. Similarly, the appreciation claim does not say a buyer is guaranteed that outcome. Strong promotion warrants scrutiny, but the quoted material does not establish the missing transaction terms.

citations.quote: 1,300,000 distributors members One Coins
It has an annual valuation of more than 700% of appreciation in less than a year.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of a spoken commission schedule does not make the appeal ordinary commerce. The speaker expressly calls it a multi-level business, presents its distributor growth as a selling point, touts rapid appreciation, and directly urges the audience to join. Together these are a recruitment-oriented investment pitch, not merely neutral information about a payment service.
